$$V_{0}=\sum_{i_{1},i_{2}}\varepsilon[(\frac{r_{0}}{R_{i_{1},i_{2}}})^{1}-(\frac{r_{0}}{R_{i_{1},i_{2}}})^{4}]=\varepsilon(\frac{r_{0}}{a})^{1}\sum_{i_{1},i_{2}}\frac{1}{(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2})^{4}}-\varepsilon(\frac{r_{0}}{a})^{4}\sum_{i_{1},i_{2}}\frac{1}{(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2})^{3}}[R_{i_{1},i_{2}}-(l_{x}a)]$$

$$\varepsilon \left[ A _ { 1 2 } \left( \frac { r _ { 0 } } { a } \right) ^ { 1 2 } - A _ { 6 } \left( \frac { r _ { 0 } } { a } \right) ^ { 6 } \right] \left[ A _ { n } - \sum _ { l _ { x } , l _ { y } } \frac { 1 } { \left( l _ { x } ^ { 2 } + l _ { y } ^ { 2 } \right) ^ { n / 2 } } \right]$$

$$\frac { \partial V _ { 0 } } { \partial a } = \varepsilon \left[ - 1 2 A _ { 1 2 } \frac { r _ { 0 } ^ { 1 2 } } { a ^ { 1 3 } } + 6 A _ { 6 } \frac { r _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } } { a ^ { 7 } } \right] = 0 .$$

$$a = ( \frac { 2 A _ { 2 } } { A _ { 6 } } ) ^ { 1 / 6 } r _ { 0 }$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-44.jpg)

$$\sum_{i,j_{t}}\frac{1}{R_{i,j_{t}}^{a}}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}\sum_{i,j_{t}}\frac{1}{\left(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2}\right)^{n+2}}=\frac{A_{n}}{a^{n}}, \quad \sum_{i,j_{t}}\frac{1}{R_{i,j_{t}}^{n+2}}=\frac{A_{n+2}}{a^{n+2}}$$

$$\begin{aligned}\begin{bmatrix}f(-l_{x},l_{y})=-f(l_{x}) \\f(l_{x},-l_{y})=-f(l_{x})\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}$$

$$\sum_{i,j,t} \frac{\tilde{R}_{i,j,t} \cdot \tilde{r}}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} = \frac{1}{a^{n+1}} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{l_x x + l_y y}{(l_x^2 + l_y^2)^{n+2+1}} = \frac{x}{a^{n+1}} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{l_x}{(l_x^2 + l_y^2)^{n+2+1}} + \frac{y}{a^{n+1}} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{l_y}{(l_x^2 + l_y^2)^{n+2+1}} = 0$$

$$\sum_{l_{i},l_{j}}\frac{(\vec{R}_{l_{i},l_{j}},\vec{r})^{2}}{R_{l_{i},l_{j}}^{n+1}}=\frac{1}{a^{n+1}}\sum_{l_{i},l_{j}}\frac{(l_{i}x+l_{j}y)^{2}}{(l_{i}^{2}+l_{j}^{2})^{n+1+2}}=\frac{1}{a^{n+1}}\sum_{l_{i},l_{j}}\frac{l_{i}^{2}x^{2}+l_{j}^{2}y^{2}+2l_{i}l_{j}xy}{(l_{i}^{2}+l_{j}^{2})^{n+1+2}}$$

$$\sum_{l_{y}} l_{y} \sum_{b} \frac{l_{x}}{\left(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2}\right)^{n/2+2}} = 0, \quad \sum_{l_{x},l_{y}} \frac{l_{x}^{2}}{\left(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2}\right)^{n/2+2}} = \sum_{l_{x},l_{y}} \frac{l_{y}^{2}}{\left(l_{x}^{2}+l_{y}^{2}\right)^{n/2+2}}$$

$$\sum_{i,j,t} \frac{(\bar{R}_{U_j} \cdot \bar{r})^{t}}{R_{U_j}^{n+1}} = \frac{1}{a^{n+2}} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{l_{i}^{2}(x^{2} + y^{2})}{(l_{i}^{2} + l_{j}^{2})^{n/2+1}} = \frac{r^{2}}{2a^{n+2}} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{(l_{i}^{2} + l_{j}^{2})^{n/2+1}} = \frac{A_{n+1}}{2a^{n+2}} r^{2} \left[ l_{i}^{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} (l_{i}^{2} + l_{j}^{2})^{n/2+1} \right]$$

$$\sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} + \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} + n \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{\tilde{R}_{i,j,t} \cdot \tilde{r}}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} - \frac{n r^2}{2} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} + \frac{n(n+2)}{2} \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{(\tilde{R}_{i,j,t} \cdot \tilde{r})^3}{R_{i,j,t}^{n+1}} \quad \tilde{R}_{i,j,t} = (l_a, l, l, d)$$

$$V_{0}+\frac{1}{2}m\times \frac{3}{5}r^{2}$$

$$V = c r _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \sum _ { i , j } \frac { 1 } { R _ { i j _ { 0 } } ^ { n + 1 } } - c r _ { 0 } ^ { 4 } \sum _ { i , j _ { 0 } } \frac { 1 } { R _ { i j _ { 0 } } ^ { n } }$$

$$\sum_{i_{t},i_{t}}\frac{1}{R_{i,i_{t}}^{n}}=\sum_{i_{t},i_{t}}\frac{1}{R_{i,i_{t}}^{n}}+n\sum_{i_{t},i_{t}}\frac{\bar{R}_{i,i_{t}}\cdot\bar{r}}{R_{i,i_{t}}^{n+1}}-\frac{nr^{2}}{2}\sum_{i_{t},i_{t}}\frac{1}{R_{i,i_{t}}^{n+1}}+\frac{n(n+2)}{2}\sum_{i_{t},i_{t}}\frac{\left(\bar{R}_{i,i_{t}}\cdot\bar{r}\right)^{2}}{R_{i,i_{t}}^{n+1}}$$

$$\sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{R_{i,j_t}^{n}} = \frac{A_{i}}{a^{n}}, \quad \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{1}{R_{i,j_t}^{n+1}} = \frac{A_{n-1}}{a^{n+1}}, \quad \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{\bar{R}_{i,j_t} \cdot \bar{r}}{R_{i,j_t}^{n+1}} = 0, \quad \sum_{i,j,t} \frac{(\bar{R}_{i,j_t} \cdot \bar{r})^{1}}{R_{i,j_t}^{n+1}} = \frac{A_{n+1}}{2a^{n+1}} r^{2}$$

(4)

$$\mathrm{d}N = \frac{N}{2} \mathrm{e}^{-kn} \frac{\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\mathrm{d}p_{\theta}\mathrm{d}p_{r}}{k_{0}^{2}} \quad (\beta = \frac{1}{kT})$$

$$\overline { { r ^ { 2 } } } = \frac { \int \overline { { r ^ { 2 } } } \mathrm { d } N } { N } = \frac { 1 } { Z } \int r ^ { 2 } \mathrm { e } ^ { - p _ { 2 } } \frac { \mathrm { d } r \mathrm { d } \theta \mathrm { d } p _ { 0 } \mathrm { d } p _ { r } } { h _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } }$$

$$\frac{1}{Z} \int r^{2} e^{- \beta ( \frac{p^{2}}{2m} + r_{0} - \frac{1}{2} m \rho^{2} r^{2} ) } \frac{\mathrm{d}r \mathrm{d}\theta \mathrm{d}p_{0} \mathrm{d}p_{r}}{h_{0}^{2}}$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-46.jpg)

$$\frac{e^{-\beta t_{0}}}{2h_{0}^{2}}\int_{0}^{\pi}r^{2}e^{-\frac{1}{2}\beta\cos^{2}r^{2}}\cdot2\pi rdr\int_{0}^{\pi}e^{-\frac{\beta r^{2}}{2m}}\cdot2\pi pdp=\frac{2kT}{\beta m\omega_{L}^{2}}=\frac{2kT}{m\omega_{L}^{2}}$$

$$\sqrt { r ^ { 2 } } = \frac { 1 } { m _ { c } } \sqrt { \frac { 2 k T } { m } }$$

$$\mathrm{d}N = \frac{N}{Z} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{\mathrm{d}\tau}} \frac{\mathrm{d}\tau}{h_0^2}$$

$$T = T _ { \mathrm { l } u } , \sqrt { r _ { \mathrm { l } l } ^ { 2 } } = \frac { 1 } { \omega _ { \mathrm { g } } } \sqrt { \frac { 2 k T _ { \mathrm { l } u } } { m } } = C _ { \mathrm { l } } a \Rightarrow T _ { \mathrm { l } u } = \frac { m ( C _ { \mathrm { l } } \omega _ { \mathrm { g } } a ) ^ { 2 } } { 2 k }$$

$$Z = \int e^{\frac{1}{\sigma}} \frac{\mathrm{d}\tau}{h_{0}^{3}}$$

$$Z = ( \frac { 2 \pi } { \beta h \sigma _ { 2 } } ) ^ { 2 } e ^ { - \beta \sigma _ { 2 } }$$

(5)

$$\boldsymbol{c}_{s}=\boldsymbol{c}_{s_{s},n_{s}}=\boldsymbol{c}_{0}+(n_{s}+n_{s})\boldsymbol{h}\boldsymbol{c}_{0}\quad(s\rightarrow n_{s},n_{s})$$

$$U = \sum_{s} E_{s} N_{s} = \frac{N}{Z} \sum_{s} E_{s} e^{-\beta \alpha_{s}} = -\frac{N}{Z} \frac{\partial}{\partial \beta} \sum_{s} e^{-\beta \alpha_{s}} = -\frac{N}{Z} \frac{\partial Z}{\partial \beta} = -\frac{N}{Z} \frac{\partial \ln Z}{\partial \beta} \left( \beta = \frac{1}{kT} \right)$$

$$Z = \sum_{n_{e},n_{p}=0}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-\beta \left(c_{q}+(n_{e}+n_{p})ba_{E}\right)} = \mathrm{e}^{-\beta c_{q}} \sum_{n_{e}=0}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-n_{e}\betaba_{E}} \sum_{n_{p}=0}^{\infty} \mathrm{e}^{-n_{p}\betaba_{E}}$$

$$e^{-\beta c_{0}}\left(\sum_{n_{1}=0}^{\infty}e^{-n_{1}\beta h\omega_{1}}\right)^{2}=\frac{e^{-\beta c_{0}}}{\left(1-e^{-\beta h\omega_{1}}\right)^{2}}$$

$$U = - N \frac{\partial \ln Z}{\partial \beta} = N_A \varepsilon_0 + \frac{2 N \hbar \omega_T}{e^{i \omega_0 / \hbar f} - 1}$$

$$C_{\gamma}=\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{\gamma}=2N_{A}k\left(\frac{\hbar\omega_{t}}{kT}\right)^{2}\frac{e^{i\omega_{t}\cdot kT}}{\left(e^{i\omega_{t}\cdot kT}-1\right)^{2}}\quad(N=N_{A})$$

$$N_{1}=\frac{N}{2}e^{-\frac{t}{\eta}}$$

$$Z = \sum_{i} e^{\frac{\theta_{i}}{H}}$$

(3)

$$c = \frac{p^{2}}{2m} + V = \frac{p^{2}}{2m} + V_{0} + \frac{1}{2}m\omega_{c}^{2}r^{2}$$

$$U = \int \varepsilon \mathrm{d}N = \frac{N}{Z} \int \varepsilon e^{-\frac{1}{kT}} \frac{\mathrm{d}\tau}{h_0^3} = \frac{N}{Z} \int \varepsilon e^{-\frac{1}{kT}} \frac{\mathrm{d}\tau}{h_0^3} \quad (\beta = \frac{1}{kT}).$$

$$- \frac { N } { Z } \frac { \partial } { \partial \beta } \int e ^ { - \beta t } \frac { d t } { h _ { 0 } ^ { 3 } } = - \frac { N } { Z } \frac { \partial Z } { \partial \beta } = - N \frac { \partial \ln Z } { \partial \beta }$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-47.jpg)

$$Z = \int_{0}^{- \frac{\pi}{2}\left( \frac{p^{2}}{2m} + V_{a} + \frac{m + 1}{2}r^{2} \right)}\frac{drd\theta d\rho_{a}d\rho_{r}}{h_{0}^{2}} = \frac{e^{- \beta V_{a}}}{h_{0}^{2}}\int_{0}^{\pi}e^{- \frac{\beta - \alpha\beta}{2}r^{2}} \cdot 2\pi rdr\int_{0}^{\pi}e^{- \frac{\beta p^{2}}{2m}} \cdot 2\pi p d\rho = \left( \frac{2\pi}{\beta h_{0}\alpha_{a}} \right)^{2}e^{- \beta V_{a}}$$

$$U = - N \frac{\partial \ln Z}{\partial \beta} = \frac{2N}{\beta} + N V_{0} = 2 N k T + N V_{0}$$

$$C_{r}=(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_{r}=2Nk=2N_{\Lambda}k\ (N=N_{\Lambda})$$

$$\mathrm{d}N = \frac{N}{Z} \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2T}} \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{h_0^2}, Z = \int \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2T}} \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{h_0^2}$$

$$V = V _ { 0 } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } m m _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } r ^ { 2 }$$

$$\varepsilon = \frac{p_{x}^{2}}{2m} + \frac{p_{y}^{2}}{2m} + \frac{1}{2}m\omega_{z}^{2}x^{2} + \frac{1}{2}m\omega_{z}^{2}y^{2} + V_{0}$$

$$\overline{\varepsilon}=\frac{\overline{p_{x}^{2}}}{2m}+\frac{\overline{p_{y}^{2}}}{2m}+\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{0}^{2}x^{2}+\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{0}^{2}y^{2}+V_{0}=2kT+V_{0}$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-48.jpg)

$$C_{V}=(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T})_{V}=2N_{\Lambda}k\ (N=N_{\Lambda})$$

(4)

$$\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{\mathrm{t}}^{2}r^{2}=\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{\mathrm{t}}^{2}r^{2}=\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{\mathrm{t}}^{2}x^{2}+\frac{1}{2}m\omega_{\mathrm{t}}^{2}y^{2}=kT\Rightarrow\sqrt{r^{2}}=\frac{1}{\omega_{\mathrm{t}}}\sqrt{\frac{2kT}{m}}$$

$$T = T _ { \mathrm { M } } , \sqrt { r _ { \mathrm { M } } ^ { 2 } } = \frac { 1 } { \omega _ { \mathrm { L } } } \sqrt { \frac { 2 k T _ { \mathrm { M } } } { m } } = C _ { \mathrm { L } } a \Rightarrow T _ { \mathrm { M } } = \frac { m ( C _ { \mathrm { L } } \omega _ { \mathrm { L } } a ) ^ { 2 } } { 2 k }$$

$$c = \frac{p^{2}}{2m} + \frac{1}{2}m\omega_{0}^{2}r^{2} + V_{0}$$

讨论:

1. C与温度T有关。

2. 高温区: $\hbar \omega_{\mathrm{p}} / k T \ll 1$

分母: $e^{\hbar \omega_{E} / kT} - 1 \approx 1 + \frac{\hbar \omega_{E}}{kT} - 1 = \frac{\hbar \omega_{E}}{kT}$ 分子: $e^{\tan \alpha} = 1$

$C_{\gamma} = 2N_{A}k$ 与不考虑量子效应的结果一致

3. 低温区: $\hbar \omega _ { \mathrm { g } } / k T \gg 1$

(1) (a) 以10℃的环境为高温热源，0℃的冰山为低温热源构建一热机。该热机从10℃的环境吸热，向冰山放热，对外做功，直到冰山全部熔化成水，且水温升至10℃为止。

(b) 以10℃的环境为低温热源，初温等于10℃的水为高温热源构建一热泵，利用刚才热机所做的功，驱动热泵工作，使10℃的水升温至100℃，并汽化变成100℃的水蒸气，直到全部功用完。

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-97.jpg)

(2) 热力学第一定律：

$$Q_2 = m_{\alpha}L_{\alpha} + m_{\alpha}c_{\alpha}(T_1 - T_0)$$

$$W = Q_1 - Q_2 = Q_1 - m_{\alpha}L_{\alpha} - m_{\alpha}c_{\alpha}(T_1 - T_0)$$

热力学第二定律：

$$\Delta S = -\frac{Q_1}{T_1} + \frac{m_{\alpha}L_{\alpha}}{T_0} + m_{\alpha}c_{\alpha}\ln\frac{T_1}{T_0} \geq 0$$

$$Q_1 \leq \frac{T_1}{T_0}m_{\alpha}L_{\alpha} + m_{\alpha}c_{\alpha}T_1\ln\frac{T_1}{T_0}$$

(3) 热力学第一定律：

$$W = Q_1' - Q_2' = m_{\text{水}}c_{\text{水}}(T_b - T_s) + m_{\text{水}}L_{\text{水}} - Q_2'$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-98.jpg)

热力学第二定律：

$$Q_1' = m_{\text{水}}c_{\text{水}}(T_b - T_s) + m_{\text{水}}L_{\text{水}}$$

$$\Delta S' = m_{\text{水}}c_{\text{水}}\ln\frac{T_b}{T_s} + \frac{m_{\text{水}}L_{\text{水}}}{T_b} - \frac{Q_2'}{T_s} \geq 0$$

$$Q_2' \leq m_{\text{水}}c_{\text{水}}T_s\ln\frac{T_b}{T_s} + \frac{T_s}{T_b}m_{\text{水}}L_{\text{水}} \quad (4)$$

由 (1)(2)(3)(4) 联立可得：

$$m_{\text{水}} \leq m_{\text{冰}}\frac{(T_s/T_0)L_{\text{冰}} + c_{\text{冰}}T_s\ln(T_s/T_0) - L_{\text{冰}} - c_{\text{冰}}(T_s - T_0)}{c_{\text{水}}(T_b - T_s) + L_{\text{水}} - c_{\text{水}}T_s\ln(T_b/T_s) - (T_s/T_b)L_{\text{水}}}$$

$$C_{v}=T\left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial T}\right)_{v}$$

$$\left( \frac{\partial C_{v}}{\partial v} \right)_{T} = T \left[ \frac{\partial}{\partial v} \left( \frac{\partial s}{\partial T} \right)_{v} \right]_{T} = T \left[ \frac{\partial}{\partial T} \left( \frac{\partial s}{\partial v} \right)_{T} \right]_{v} = T \left[ \frac{\partial}{\partial T} \left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_{v} \right]_{v} = T \left( \frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial T^2} \right)_{v}$$

$$C_{v}=T\left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial T}\right)_{v},\quad \left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial v}\right)_{T}=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{v}$$

(2)

一般情况：$C_{v}=C_{v}(T,v)$

先证明：$C_{v}=C_{v}(T)$

$$\left(p+\frac{a}{v^{2}}\right)(v-b)=RT \Rightarrow \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{v}=\frac{R}{v-b}$$

$$\left( \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } p } { \partial T ^ { 2 } } \right) _ { v } = \left( \frac { \partial } { \partial T } \frac { R } { v - b } \right) _ { v } = 0 , \quad \left( \frac { \partial C _ { v } } { \partial v } \right) _ { T } = T \left( \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } p } { \partial T ^ { 2 } } \right) _ { v } = 0$$

由于 $C_{v}=C_{v}(T)$，保持温度不变，使系统体积 $v \to \infty$，$C_{v}$ 不变。

$v\to\infty$ 时，范氏气体成为理想气体，对单原子理想气体，$C_{v}=3R/2$

$$C_{v} = \frac{3}{2}R = \text{常量}$$

(3)

$$\left(p + \frac{a}{v^{2}}\right)(v - b) = RT,\quad \left(\frac{\partial C_{v}}{\partial v}\right)_{T} = T\left(\frac{\partial^{2}p}{\partial T^{2}}\right)_{v}$$

(4)

$$s = s(T, v) \Rightarrow$$

$$\mathrm{d}s = \left( \frac{\partial s}{\partial T} \right)_{v} \mathrm{d}T + \left( \frac{\partial s}{\partial v} \right)_{T} \mathrm{d}v = \frac{C_{v}}{T} \mathrm{d}T + \left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_{v} \mathrm{d}v = \frac{C_{v}}{T} \mathrm{d}T + \frac{R}{v - b} \mathrm{d}v$$

$$s(T,v)=\int \frac{C_v}{T} \mathrm{d}T + \int \frac{R}{v-b} \mathrm{d}v = C_v \ln T + R \ln(v-b) + s_0$$

绝热过程：$s = C_{v} \ln T + R \ln(v - b) + s_{0} = \text{常量}$

$$T(v - b)^{R/C_v} = \text{常量}$$

$$\left( \frac { \partial p } { \partial T} \right)_{v} = \frac { R } { v - b }$$

$$\Delta u = W + Q$$

$$h_{2}=h_{1}$$

(3)

$$u = u(T,v)$$

$$\mathrm{d}u = \left( \frac{\partial u}{\partial T} \right)_{v} \mathrm{d}T + \left( \frac{\partial u}{\partial v} \right)_{T} \mathrm{d}v = C_{v} \mathrm{d}T + \left[ T \left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_{v} - p \right] \mathrm{d}v$$

$$\left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_v = \frac{R}{v - b} \Rightarrow T \left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_v = \frac{RT}{v - b} = p + \frac{a}{v^2}$$

$$\mathrm{d}u = C_{v} \mathrm{d}T + \frac{a}{v^{2}} \mathrm{d}v$$

$$u(T,v)=\int C_{v}\mathrm{d}T+\int \frac{a}{v^{2}}\mathrm{d}v=C_{v}T-\frac{a}{v}+u_{0}$$

$$\left( p + \frac{a}{v^{2}} \right)(v - b) = RT,\quad \left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_{v} = \frac{R}{v - b},\quad \left( \frac{\partial U}{\partial V} \right)_{T} = T\left( \frac{\partial p}{\partial T} \right)_{v} - p$$

另解:

$$s(T,v)=\int \frac{C_{v}}{T}\mathrm{d}T+\int \frac{R}{v-b}\mathrm{d}v=C_{v}\ln T+R\ln(v-b)+s_{0}$$

$$T^{C_{v}/R}(v - b) = 常量$$

$$\mathrm{d}u = C_{v} \mathrm{d}T + \frac{a}{v^{2}} \mathrm{d}v$$

$$s(T,v)=C_{v}\ln T+R\ln(v-b)+s_{0}= 常量$$

$$(p + \frac{a}{v^2})(v - b) = RT \Rightarrow p = \frac{RT}{v - b} - \frac{a}{v^2}$$

$$S = \int \frac { d Q } { T } ,\quad d u = C _ { v } d T + \frac { a } { v^2 } d v$$

$$\mathrm{d}w = p\mathrm{d}v = (\frac{RT}{v - b} - \frac{a}{v^2})\mathrm{d}v$$

$$\mathrm{d}s = \frac{\mathrm{d}Q}{T} = \frac{C_{v}}{T}\mathrm{d}T + \frac{R}{v - b}\mathrm{d}v$$

$$\mathrm{d}Q = \mathrm{d}u + \mathrm{d}w = C_{v}\mathrm{d}T + \frac{RT}{v - b}\mathrm{d}v$$

2→3 绝热

4→1绝热:

$$T _ { 1 } ^ { C _ { v } / R } ( v _ { 1 } - b ) = T _ { 2 } ^ { C _ { v } / R } ( v _ { 2 } - b )$$

$$T _ { i } ^ { C _ { v } / R } ( v _ { i } - b ) = T _ { j } ^ { C _ { v } / R } ( v _ { j } - b )$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-102.jpg)

$$(1)(2) \Rightarrow \frac{v_{2}-b}{v_{1}-b}=\frac{v_{1}-b}{v_{4}-b}$$

$$\eta = 1 - \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}$$

$$\eta = 1 - \frac{T_{2}}{T_{1}}$$

$$\Delta Q = C _ { v } \Delta T$$

(2)

$$d h = T d s + v d p$$

$( \frac { \partial s } { \partial p } ) _ { T } = - ( \frac { \partial s } { \partial h } ) _ { T } ( \frac { \partial h } { \partial p } ) _ { T } = - \frac { ( \partial h / \partial p ) _ { T } } { ( \partial h / \partial T ) _ { T } } = - \frac { v } { T } < 0$ 压强减小，熵增大

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}p} = \left( \frac{\partial T}{\partial p} \right)_{h} = - \left( \frac{\partial T}{\partial h} \right)_{p} \left( \frac{\partial h}{\partial p} \right)_{T} = \frac{1}{C_{p}} \left[ T \left( \frac{\partial v}{\partial T} \right)_{p} - v \right]$$

$$(p + \frac{a}{v^2})(v - b) = RT \Rightarrow \left[p + \frac{a}{v^2} - \frac{2a}{v^2}(v - b)\right](\frac{\partial v}{\partial T})_{p} = R$$

$$( \frac { \partial v } { \partial T } ) _ { p } = \frac { R } { p + \frac { a } { v ^ { 2 } } - \frac { 2 a } { v ^ { 2 } } ( v - b ) } = \frac { R } { \frac { R T } { v - b } - \frac { 2 a } { v ^ { 2 } } ( v - b ) } = \frac { R v ^ { 2 } ( v - b ) } { R T v ^ { 2 } - 2 a ( v - b ) ^ { 2 } }$$

$$\frac { \mathrm { d } T } { \mathrm { d } p } = \frac { v } { C _ { p } } \frac { 2 a ( v - b ) ^ { 2 } - R T b v ^ { 2 } } { R T v ^ { 3 } - 2 a ( v - b ) ^ { 2 } }$$

(3)

先求vT满足的条件:

$$\kappa_{T}=-\frac{1}{v}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial p}\right)_{T}=\frac{1}{v}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial T}\right)_{p}\left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial p}\right)_{v}=\frac{v^{2}(v-b)^{2}}{RTv^{3}-2a(v-b)^{2}}>0$$

$$RTv^{3}-2a(v-b)^{2}>0$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}p}>0\Rightarrow\frac{2a(v-b)^{2}-RTbv^{2}}{RTv^{3}-2a(v-b)^{2}}>0\Rightarrow2a(v-b)^{2}>RTbv^{2}$$

$$\Rightarrow v > \frac{b}{1 - x} = v_{\min} \quad (x = \sqrt{\frac{bRT}{2a}})$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}p}=\frac{v}{C_{p}}\frac{2a(v-b)^{2}-RTbv^{2}}{RTv^{3}-2a(v-b)^{2}},\quad \left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_{v}=\frac{R}{v-b},\quad \left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial T}\right)_{p}=\frac{Rv^{3}(v-b)}{RTv^{3}-2a(v-b)^{2}}$$

(4)

$$\frac{a}{b^{2}}(-3x^{2}+4x-1)\geq p>0$$

$$\frac{1}{3} < x < 1$$

$$\frac { 2 a } { 9 R b } < T < \frac { 2 a } { R b }$$

$$T_{\max }=\frac{2a}{Rb},T_{\min }=\frac{2a}{9Rb}$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-103.jpg)

$$p < \frac{a}{b^{2}}( - 3x^{2} + 4x - 1)(x = \sqrt{\frac{bRT}{2a}})$$

(2)

为保证冰雪覆盖面积不再减少， $T_{g}=T_{0}=273K$

$$T_{0}=\left(\frac{1-\alpha}{4-2\beta}\right)^{1/2}\sqrt{\frac{R_{s}}{d}}T_{0}\Rightarrow\alpha=1-\left(1-\alpha\right)\left(\frac{T_{0}}{T_{s}}\right)^{4}\approx0.435$$

设冰雪覆盖面积占总面积的比例为x，则

$$\bar{a}=a^{\prime}x+a(1-x)\Rightarrow x=\frac{\bar{a}-a}{a^{\prime}-a}\times25\%$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-104.jpg)

$$T_{z} = (\frac{1 - \alpha}{4 - 2\beta})^{1/4} \sqrt{\frac{R_{s}}{d}}T_{s} = 288K$$

(2)

单位时间内，入射到dA，沿立体角 $\Delta \Omega = \sin \theta \Delta \varphi \Delta \theta$ 的辐射动量大小:

$\mathrm{d}P = \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{c} \cdot c \cos \theta \mathrm{d}A = \frac{u}{4\pi} \sin \theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\varphi \mathrm{d}\theta \mathrm{d}A$

这部分动量被容器完全吸收。

单位时间内，从dA发出，沿立体角 $d \Omega ^ { \prime } = \sin \theta d \varphi d \theta$ 的辐射动量大小:

对各向同性的平衡辐射， $\Delta P = \Delta P$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-105.jpg)

因吸收和发出上述辐射，dA受到的作用力为

$$\mathrm{d}F = 2\mathrm{d}P\cos\theta = \frac{u}{2\pi}\sin\theta\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\varphi\mathrm{d}\theta\mathrm{d}A$$

dA受到的总作用力为:

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-106.jpg)

$$p \mathrm{d}A = \frac{u \mathrm{d}A}{2 \pi} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin \theta \cos^2 \theta \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{2 \pi} \mathrm{d}\varphi = \frac{1}{3} u \mathrm{d}A \Rightarrow p = \frac{1}{3} u$$

$$d u = \frac { \pi } { 4 \pi } \sin \theta d \varphi d \theta$$

再求p,T满足的条件:

二. 相对论动力学

(2) 解注一:范度变换

在实验室参照系中，当反应后质子和反质子的动能均为零时，所需能量最小，且不违背动量守恒定律。

在质心参照系中，当反应后质子和反质子的动能均为零时，所需能量最小，且不违背动量守恒定律。

$$
p + p \rightarrow p + p + p + p
$$

$$
\frac { 2 m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } } { \sqrt { 1 - v _ { \min } ^ { 2 } / c ^ { 2 } } } = 4 m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } \Rightarrow v _ { \min } ^ { 2 } = \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 2 } c
$$

$$
v = \frac{2v'}{1 + v'^{2}/c^{2}} \Rightarrow \frac{\partial v}{\partial v'} = \frac{2(1 - v'^{2}/c^{2})}{(1 + v'^{2}/c^{2})^{2}} > 0
$$

是单调函数。

实验室参照系

$$
v _ { \max } = \frac { 2 v _ { \max }' } { 1 + v _ { \max }' ^ { 2 } / c ^ { 2 } } = \frac { 4 \sqrt { 3 } } { 7 } c
$$

$$
E_{\mathrm{kin}}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{p}}c^{2}}{\sqrt{1-v_{\mathrm{min}}^{2}/c^{2}}}-m_{\mathrm{p}}c^{2}=6m_{\mathrm{p}}c^{2}=5.630\times10^{3}\mathrm{~MeV}
$$

$$
E _ { 2 } = E - m _ { 2 } c ^ { 2 } = 2 ( \frac { E ^ { 2 } } { m _ { 2 } c ^ { 2 } } - m _ { 2 } c ^ { 2 } )
$$

E是E的单调函数。

$$
p + p \rightarrow p + p + p + p
$$

$$
E _ { \mathrm { kin } } = 2 ( \frac { E _ { \mathrm { tot } } ^ { 2 } } { m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } } - m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } ) = 6 m _ { p } c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
E _ { m } ^ { \prime } = 2 m c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
E = \frac { 2 E ^ { 2 } } { m c ^ { 2 } } - m c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
(1) \quad n \to p + e
$$

$$
E _ { 1 } + E _ { 2 } = m _ { n } c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$

$$

$$
E _ { p } ^ { 2 } = ( m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } + p _ { p } ^ { 2 } c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
E _ { \mathrm { e } } = \frac { ( m _ { n } ^ { 2 } + m _ { e } ^ { 2 } - m _ { p } ^ { 2 } ) c ^ { 2 } } { 2 m _ { n } }
$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-325.jpg)

$$

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-326.jpg)

副注二:动量一能量变换

在实验室参照系中，当反应后质子和反质子的动能均为零时，所需能量最小，且不违背动量守恒定律。

在质心参照系中，当反应后质子和反质子的动能均为零时，所需能量最小，且不违背动量守恒定律。

$$
2 E _ { \mathrm { min } } ^ { \prime } = 4 m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } \Rightarrow E _ { \mathrm { min } } ^ { \prime } = 2 m _ { p } c ^ { 2 }
$$

$$
E ^ { \prime } = \gamma _ { c } ( m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } - 0 ) \Rightarrow \gamma _ { c } = \frac { E ^ { \prime } } { m _ { p } c ^ { 2 } }
$$

实验室参照系

$$
\mathrm{p}+\mathrm{p} \rightarrow \mathrm{p}+\mathrm{p}+\mathrm{p}+\overline{\mathrm{p}}
$$

$$
\beta_{c}=\sqrt{1-\frac{1}{\gamma_{c}^{2}}}=\frac{\sqrt{E^{2}-m_{p}^{2}c^{4}}}{E^{\prime}}=\frac{p^{\prime}c}{E^{\prime}}
$$

$$
E = \gamma_{c}(E^{*} + \beta_{c}p^{*}c) = \frac{E^{2} + p^{*}c^{2}}{m_{p}c^{2}} = \frac{2E^{2}}{m_{p}c^{2}} - m_{p}c^{2}
$$

解注三，动量一能量不变量

$$

$$
p + p \rightarrow p + p + p + p

$$

$$

$$
E_{m \omega} = \frac{\left( \sum E_{i} \right)^{2} - 2\left( m_{y}c^{2} \right)^{2}}{2m_{y}c^{2}} = \frac{\left( 4m_{y}c^{2} \right)^{2} - 2\left( m_{y}c^{2} \right)^{2}}{2m_{y}c^{2}} = 7m_{y}c^{2}
$$

$$
E _ { \max } = E _ { \min } - m _ { r } c ^ { 2 } = 6 m _ { r } c ^ { 2 } = 5 . 6 3 0 \times 1 0 ^ { 3 } \mathrm{MeV}

(2)

![](data/images/2024-af1e9b07/2024-苏国珍-热光近-答案-327.jpg)
